title: Factory before/after screenshots for polish runs
acceptance: shots.mjs captures base vs branch via e2e/factory-shots.spec.ts, compares pixels, and publishes shots/review/ (tested: pixelDiff)
The spec is skipped unless FACTORY_SHOTS is set, so CI e2e is unaffected
Capture cannot reach live data: it runs under the existing Supabase-neutered playwright.config.ts
factory-polish skill, director.md, README, installer and the one CLAUDE.md line state the standing rule
Raw screenshot sets are gitignored; only shots/review/ is committed
